gloss: table clock; desk clock; mantel clock

definitions.gloss: table clock; desk clock; mantel clock
definitions.explanation: A clock designed to be placed on a table, desk, shelf, or mantelpiece, as opposed to a wall clock or wristwatch.

examples.japanese: {置時計|おきどけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{置時計|おきどけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}っている→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: I have a clock displayed on the shelf.

examples.japanese: ⟦アンティーク→アンティーク：30728_antiiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{置時計|おきどけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}っている→合う：10466_au⟧。
examples.english: The antique mantel clock suits the atmosphere of the room.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧ (to place) + ⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧ (clock/watch). Refers specifically to a freestanding clock meant to sit on a surface.
